title: cheapest way to host nodejs app
linkedin:
> It depends on stage.

For a demo or learning project, a free tier is cheapest, accepting that it sleeps and the first visitor waits. For a real app, the cheapest option is usually a flat plan that bundles the app, its database, and bandwidth, because per-piece and per-usage billing add up faster than a single server does. A bare VPS is cheapest on the invoice and most expensive in your time, since patching, backups, and incidents become your job.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/cheapest-way-to-host-nodejs-app/
